title: Can your signals explain an unfamiliar failure?
description: Select an incident, choose where the investigation starts, and change the shared context. Watch the evidence path connect or break.

scenarios.label: Checkout latency
scenarios.detail: p99 rises in one region just after a routine release.
scenarios.symptom: Checkout p99 exceeds 2 seconds in eu-west after version 4.18 ships.
scenarios.rootCause: A new inventory client retry loop amplifies one slow dependency.
scenarios.action: Disable the retry flag and roll back the inventory client.

evidence.label: Regional latency SLI
evidence.detail: The alert constrains the journey, region, window, and severity.

evidence.label: Slow trace exemplar
evidence.detail: Inventory spans repeat three times and dominate the critical path.

evidence.label: Retry decision event
evidence.detail: Structured fields record attempt, timeout class, and dependency.

evidence.label: Version and flag change
evidence.detail: The client version and retry flag connect the path to an owner.

scenarios.label: Duplicate charges
scenarios.detail: Payment success is normal, but customers report duplicate charges.
scenarios.symptom: The duplicate-charge business SLI rises while HTTP success stays healthy.
scenarios.rootCause: A queue retry replays payment capture without an idempotency record.
scenarios.action: Pause the consumer, enable the idempotency guard, and reconcile duplicates.

evidence.label: Duplicate outcome metric
evidence.detail: A business invariant detects a failure hidden by transport success.

evidence.label: Linked producer and consumer
evidence.detail: Message links reveal two captures for one logical payment.

evidence.label: Idempotency event
evidence.detail: Payment ID, attempt, and guard result explain the duplicate effect.

evidence.label: Consumer deployment
evidence.detail: The running version lacks the required idempotency write.

scenarios.label: Regional signal loss
scenarios.detail: Dashboards look healthy while one collector tier is saturated.
scenarios.symptom: Request volume appears to fall 35% in ap-south without a traffic shift.
scenarios.rootCause: Collector queues fill after a high-cardinality metric release.
scenarios.action: Drop the unbounded label, shed low-priority telemetry, and restore collector headroom.

evidence.label: Traffic reconciliation gap
evidence.detail: Edge counts disagree with the service telemetry received downstream.

evidence.label: Trace coverage gap
evidence.detail: Sampled request IDs exist at the edge but disappear before export.

evidence.label: Collector refusal event
evidence.detail: Queue saturation and refused-item fields expose telemetry loss.

evidence.label: Metric schema release
evidence.detail: A request-ID label causes the active series explosion.

startingSignals.label: User outcome alert
startingSignals.detail: Start with the affected journey, window, and severity.

startingSignals.label: Infrastructure dashboard
startingSignals.detail: Scan CPU, memory, and network before constraining user impact.

startingSignals.label: Search all logs
startingSignals.detail: Begin in the largest event source without a trace or route constraint.

contextContracts.label: Isolated signal stores
contextContracts.detail: Only timestamps and free-text service names are shared.

contextContracts.label: Trace ID only
contextContracts.detail: Requests connect to events, but versions and ownership are missing.

contextContracts.label: Trace, resource, and change context
contextContracts.detail: Signals share service, operation, version, region, trace, and owner.
